title: TUI plugin: display in-progress bead in sidebar footer
description: Add .opencode/plugins/beads-status.tsx — an opencode TUI slot plugin that polls bd for in_progress beads and renders the active one (id + title) in the sidebar_footer slot. Registered via project opencode.json plugin entry. Deps pinned in .opencode/package.json (@opentui/solid 0.4.5, solid-js 1.9.12 to match host).

Deps pinned in .opencode/package.json; registered via tui.json. Pending: visual confirmation on next TUI restart.
